name: changepoint_detection_v1
author: claude-4.6-opus-agent-4
thesis: Intraday price series experience structural breaks — sudden changes in mean return or volatility caused by news, large orders, or sentiment shifts. By detecting these changepoints in real-time using CUSUM (Cumulative Sum) control charts on 1-min returns, we identify the moment a new regime begins. A positive CUSUM break (cumulative returns exceed threshold) signals a new uptrend regime; trade in that direction. A negative CUSUM break signals a new downtrend. The edge comes from entering at the very beginning of a new regime rather than waiting for lagging indicators (like EMA crossovers) to confirm. The inefficiency persists because CUSUM is a quality control technique from manufacturing, rarely applied to finance.

indicators.name: CUSUM_Pos
indicators.params: max(0, CUSUM_Pos[-1] + Return_1min - Rolling_Mean_Return - k) where k = 0.5 * std(Return_1min, 30)

indicators.name: Changepoint_Signal
indicators.params: +1 if CUSUM_Pos > CUSUM_Threshold; -1 if abs(CUSUM_Neg) > CUSUM_Threshold; 0 otherwise

conditions: Changepoint_Signal == +1 (positive CUSUM break — new uptrend regime detected)
CUSUM_Pos just exceeded threshold within last 3 bars (fresh break, not stale)
long.confirmation: ROC(close, 3) > 5 bps (momentum in new regime direction)

conditions: Changepoint_Signal == -1 (negative CUSUM break — new downtrend regime detected)
abs(CUSUM_Neg) just exceeded threshold within last 3 bars

exit.trailing_stop: After 25 bps profit, trail at 15 bps from high-water mark
exit.signal_exit: Opposite Changepoint_Signal detected (new regime shift against position) OR CUSUM resets to 0 (regime ended)

risk.position_sizing: Fixed ₹1L; increase to ₹1.25L if CUSUM exceeds 2x threshold (very strong structural break)

filters.vix_filter: India VIX < 25; adjust CUSUM_Threshold (h) proportionally to VIX level
filters.time_filter: No entries before 09:25 (need 30 bars for rolling statistics) or after 15:10
filters.volume_filter: Volume on changepoint bar > 1.5 * SMA(volume, 20) (structural breaks should be accompanied by volume)
filters.trend_filter: NIFTY 50 must not have a simultaneous opposing changepoint
filters.event_filter: Skip stock on earnings day — changepoints are expected and not exploitable
other_filters: CUSUM must have been below threshold for at least 20 bars before break (fresh signal, not continuation)

edge.edge_decay_risk: Low — CUSUM changepoint detection is from quality control (Page 1954), rarely applied to financial time series in real-time; the early detection provides timing advantage over lagging indicators

weaknesses: The CUSUM parameters k (allowable slack) and h (threshold) critically affect the trade-off between detection speed and false alarm rate — the standard k=0.5*sigma, h=4*sigma may not be optimal for financial data
CUSUM assumes the change is a step-function shift in mean — but financial regime shifts are often gradual (ramping) or volatile (noisy), causing delayed detection or false triggers
The 'fresh break' requirement (CUSUM exceeded threshold within last 3 bars) can miss slow-building changepoints where CUSUM gradually approaches and crosses the threshold over many bars
prior_art: Page (1954) CUSUM test; Basseville & Nikiforov (1993) 'Detection of Abrupt Changes'; Andreou & Ghysels (2002) on structural breaks in financial data; CUSUM applied to trading in some quant research papers
notes: Consider using Bayesian Online Changepoint Detection (Adams & MacKay 2007) for probabilistic changepoint estimation that avoids hard threshold decisions. The ruptures Python library provides multiple changepoint detection algorithms with different computational trade-offs.
